prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop web app UI composition for a new Analytics workspace in the existing ASC Studio application. Use the attached ASC Studio Overview screenshot strictly as the identity and chrome reference: preserve its exact left sidebar proportions, top bar height, light neutral canvas, white flat panels, blue accent, Inter-like typography, thin gray hairlines, compact 7–9px corner radii, restrained status colors, readable 13–17px operational text, and shadowless professional operator feel. Do not copy the Overview page's content or panel arrangement.

Viewport is a wide 1919×1088 desktop app screenshot. Keep the existing sidebar and app picker. Insert Analytics directly below Overview in the sidebar and make Analytics the active soft-blue row. Existing items TestFlight, Releases, Apple Ads, Reviews remain visible. Header: "Analytics" with subtitle "Performance, acquisition, and revenue for GLP-1 Peptide Tracker: Vitadel." Right side has date range "Last 30 days", Compare "Previous period", Filters, and a quiet "Refresh" control. All visualized values are clearly labeled "Sample data" in a small neutral badge so no screenshot implies live facts.

Direction: ANALYSIS NOTEBOOK. This is a saved-view report notebook, not a generic KPI-card dashboard. Immediately below the header, create a narrow vertical saved-view rail inside the workspace, with "Performance pulse" selected and saved views "Acquisition by source", "Mexico conversion", "Release 1.1.4 impact", plus a small New view action. The main evidence canvas owns most width. Its top has a compact pinned metric strip with four truthful categories: Downloads 12,480 +8.4%, Product page views 38,210 +3.1%, Conversion 32.7% +1.6 pt, Proceeds $18,420 +11.2%. Each metric has a tiny source/freshness label such as "Analytics · complete through Aug 18" or "Sales · complete through Aug 19"; do not show an overall rating.

Dominant focal moment: one broad comparison time-series chart titled "Downloads and proceeds" spanning most of the main canvas, with a blue current-period line, muted gray previous-period line, a restrained release annotation at Aug 6, and a soft highlighted interval. The chart is legible and calm, not decorative. Under it, split into two compact evidence panels: "What moved" ranked contribution rows (United States +620 downloads, Mexico +310, App Store Search +280, Product page GLP-1 Basics -94) with horizontal contribution bars; and "What changed" containing two concise deterministic evidence notes tied to exact dates/metrics, each with a source link icon and cautious language like "coincided with", never implying causality. A lower notebook footer shows "Freshness & coverage": engagement complete through Aug 17, downloads through Aug 19, usage opt-in 24%, privacy-suppressed rows shown as missing, not zero.

Use line charts and semantic HTML-style controls, no gradients, no glass, no oversized typography, no bento-card collage, no fake AI sparkle motif, no dark theme, no 3D, no illustrations. The surface's job must read instantly as reusable, evidence-backed app performance analysis. Produce only the UI screenshot, no surrounding device frame, no browser chrome, no caption outside the app.
